semantic_ops.Linear: Projection by a learned matrix. Not FullyConnected — that is TFLite's word; not Gemm or MatMul — those demote a projection to a matrix multiply.
semantic_ops.RMSNorm: Root-mean-square normalization. The paper's name; PyTorch, JAX and LiteRT all use it.
semantic_ops.RoPE: Rotary position embedding. The paper's name.
semantic_ops.Attention: Attention proper — score, softmax, weighted sum. Not SDPA: gemma-4 sets score_scale = 1.0, so "scaled" would contradict the data.
semantic_ops.GELU: Gaussian error linear unit. The paper's name, all caps — an acronym is spelled the way it is spelled, like RoPE and RMSNorm.
semantic_ops.Add: Elementwise addition. Mathematics, not an implementation.
